assignments.instruction: Stage: Report to the warming tent immediately for cold stress support.

reason: Medic-1 was sent to the warming tent at Stage due to severe cold wind stress.
announcement_en: Extreme cold alert! A warming tent is now open at the Stage area for anyone needing shelter from the wind and cold.
announcement_fr: Alerte de froid extrême! Une tente de réchauffement est ouverte à la Scène pour s'abriter du vent.
